description:
Yoon Heesoo has lived a lonely life after being abandoned by his family and betrayed by the only person he trusted. While working to make ends meet, he accidentally witnesses a violent crime and encounters Shin Gyoyeon, the dangerous man responsible. Instead of killing Heesoo, Gyoyeon takes him home and keeps him by his side. Frightened at first, Heesoo soon finds himself confused by Gyoyeon’s unexpected care and possessiveness. Having never experienced such attention before, he gradually becomes drawn into a dark and complicated relationship with the man he should fear most.  
“I’m glad you’re not a minor.”“Yes…”  
“Though I suppose that’s unfortunate for you, baby.”
